notes.title: Christmas update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35820847/f7c34b7d2a4fd2182ac1c467047d2300866514b4.jpg[/img]

Christmas is coming so Let's Go make a Christmas update as well!

We've added two new maps you can play on! They both have a new noticeable feature. Which one? Play new maps and you'll notice it! then please tell us what you thinking about it.

Existing map now have a new fancy looks.

Performance optimised.
Game client now haev reduced size as well.

Merry Christmas!
